subject: File description entry
notes: Rule: 'A file description entry associates file-name-1 with a file connector.' (cite.py --check 13.4.5.4 -> OK §13.4.5.4 1)). BindFileSection attaches each FD to the FileModel of its SELECT (FilesByName) and the emitters register exactly one connector per FileModel ('CobolFile.Register("<prog>::F", ...)' observed in every probe's .g.cs), including a record-description-less FD (PB345, landed) and a report FD. EXTERNAL makes the association run-unit-wide (probe probe/fde/gr2/gr2.cob: two programs writing through one external connector interleave MAIN1/SUB1/MAIN2 in one file). The FD-without-SELECT direction is SR-13.4.5.3-1's (DIVERGES, separate row). pb345_record_less_fd_area is spec-derived (SR3 + GR6) and exercises the connector association on the hardest shape. || Editions (adjudicator): 85, 2002, 2014, 2023 (the file description entry and this rule exist in every edition; no Annex E item touches 13.4.5)
